scope: Manual production deployment without numbered website releases or home-page release UI

workflow.repeatDispatch: Always builds and deploys, including an unchanged source commit
workflow.validation: Latest successful main-push Oxytype CI run for the exact workflow snapshot
workflow.buildId: Source SHA + workflow run ID + run attempt; internal cache/diagnostic identity
workflow.deployment: Matched client/Worker build, artifact checks, compatible D1 migrations, Wrangler deployment
workflow.privateSettings: Ephemeral runner files mode 0600; removed on success or failure

validation.dryRun: dry-run:start (local generated Worker config; no deployment)
validation.regression: Deployment-only workflow assertions fail on the prior numbered-release workflow, pass after replacement
